content.title: School Calendar | Prince William County Public Schools
content.text: 2025-26 School Year Calendar Printable 2025-26 Month-at-a-Glance Calendar (PDF) Print Version of 2025-26 School Calendar (PDF - 11" x 17") Approved November 2024Last updated March 18, 2026 The 2025-26 school calendar’s first day of school for students will be August 18, 2025, and the last day of school will be Friday, June 12, 2026. Schools will be closed for winter break from Monday, December 22, 2025, through Friday, January 2, 2026. Schools will reopen on Monday, January 5, 2026. Spring break will be observed March 30 - April 3, 2026, which will be followed by a teacher workday with no school for students on Monday, April 6, 2026. A complete list of holidays and observances throughout the year is provided in the print version of 2025-26 school calendar (PDF). 2026-27 School Year Printable 2026-27 Month-at-a-Glance Calendar (PDF) Approved December 2025 The 2026-27 school calendar’s first day of school for students will be August 24, 2026, and the last day of school will be Thursday, June 17, 2027. Schools will be closed for winter break from Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Schools will reopen on Monday, January 4, 2027. Spring break will be observed March 22-26, 2027, which will be followed by a teacher workday with no school for students on Monday, March 29, 2027.
